newsitem.title: UK: GWR to buy commercial radio operator.
newsitem.headline: GWR to buy commercial radio operator.

text.p: Radio franchise operator GWR Group said on Tuesday it had agreed to purchase Radio Wyvern for about 3.9 million stg.
GWR has agreed to pay 7.55 stg per share, plus a notional interest of 24 pence per share, it said in a statement.
Radio Wyvern is a commercial radio operator for Hereford and Worcester in western England.
"The acquisition would increase the enlarged group's attractiveness and potential to advertisers and sponsors," said GWR chairman Henry Meakin.
Meakin said the company expected the deal would enhance its earnings per share for the year ending March 31, 1998.
